subject: Linguistics
title: Quantifiers and Scope
description: A short lesson to help you apply Quantifiers and Scope.

hook.text: 'Every student read a book.' Did they all read the same book, or each a different one?

buildup.text: Quantifiers like 'every,' 'some,' and 'no' specify how many entities are involved.

discovery.text: Scope determines which quantifier takes precedence—different scopes yield different meanings.

twist.text: English word order doesn't always resolve scope—both readings are grammatically valid.

climax.text: Formal semantics uses logical notation to specify exactly which reading is intended.

punchline.text: The same words can count things two different ways.
